title: Street Detectives review quiz
subject: Geography

source: Seeded from geography/y2 lesson 8 (Street Detectives review quiz (portal quiz; assessed))
intro: Covers lessons 6 to 8 of My local area, maps and aerial images (Street Detectives). Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.a: B) A lamp post. People built the lamp post; streams and hills are natural.

questions.q: On most maps, north is at the:
questions.a: B) Top. Maps usually have north at the top; south is at the bottom.

options: A machine circling Earth in space
questions.a: A) A machine circling Earth in space. Satellites go round the Earth in space and take pictures; planes fly much lower.
